dataset_contract: For each sampled turn, store the deterministic top-eight distinct completed-turn states, native static and full-opponent-turn reply scores, full-turn actions, selected teacher index, root seat and post-turn BatchObservation. Do not run terminal continuations for every candidate. Record incomplete maps separately.
first_candidate: Retrain the frozen routed-v6 two-player spatial encoder plus 17 root-conditioned features with the same fixed map-balanced and static-versus-override-balanced 200-step linear teacher-choice head. Compare to always selecting static rank zero on fresh map-disjoint validation; do not tune on final seeds.
promotion: No rating or deployment without frozen inference code, fresh complete both-seat games grouped by independent map against plain beam-256 and the reply-search teacher, profile regression checks and measured runtime. The full-game seed window remains untouched during offline model selection.
resources: Compute only on SSH server with a single nice-19 CPU process and compressed per-shard output. Recheck aggregate disk, memory and other user workloads before every larger run; no GPU unless safely free, no preemption or private-data inspection.
